title: ID0397290-DC/Si-D/FR[oPGxEC] - Different key for CCV
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
CCV has the key OPx C60 Cardprocess SW56(see attached photo), whereas our other terminals use either OPx C60 CCV-KNB SW56 or OPx C60 Bs PAYONE SW56
Root cause:
the terminal has the key 08 loaded on it, which is a key for Cardprocess. The right key for the TID 40800506 would be 02, which is the correct one for CCV KNB
Solution:
The terminal will need to be replaced by a terminal with the right keys loaded on it
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
No
Warranty Status:
Expired

additional_info.subject: ID0397290-DC/Si-D/FR[oPGxEC] - Different key for CCV CRM:00315002217
additional_info.body:
Dear colleagues,
Mr. Chetouah from Engie raised this ticket regarding a CCV OPM-C60 where the Key is not the correct one as it seems from a different CCV. Since Network Operator Key is "hard-coded" and linked to the terminal hardware, processing Unit needs to be exchanged if the terminal is installed with the wrong key.
Please check also if when you ordered the with MLFB code this was the correct one:
If it's the correct one then it's possible that the wrong terminal was sent and needs to be checked with QM from Leipzig.
